definition: Patrick Esser is the co-creator of VQGAN, Stable Diffusion, Rectified Flow, and FLUX.
details: Co-invented VQGAN and Latent Diffusion, and co-founded Black Forest Labs. Patrick J. 'Pat' Esser is the Chairman of C-Span. He was formerly the chief executive officer of Cox Communications. Esser assumed the role of president of the cable television company owned by Cox Enterprises in 2006. The announcement was made as part of a re-organization of the top three executives at the company, triggered by the retirement of James O. Robbins and Jimmy W. Hayes move to Cox Enterprises. After the changes, Esser reported to Hayes, who assumed the role of president and COO of Cox Enterprises.

explainer.lead: Patrick Esser is a Chief executive officer of Cox Communications.

timeline.what: Esser entered the cable industry in 1979 and first joined Cox later that year in its Hampton Roads, Virginia, system.
After working in various marketing and advertising sales roles, Cox promoted Esser to vice president of advertising sales in 1991 and senior vice president of operations in 1999.
He holds a B.A. and M.A. in communications media and is a 2003 recipient of the university's Heritage Honors Alumni Achievement Award.
In 2007, Esser was named Executive of the Year by industry publication Multichannel News.
